id: title:MattBro:stop self serve plan changes for vercel billed orgs

review.posthog_relevance: Adds backend support and API exception handling for Vercel as an external billing provider, including invoice URL construction and billing state display.
review.reason: The change group introduces a new billing provider capability. P1.F2.H3 adds a specific API exception for billing refusal, P1.F2.H4 and P1.F2.H5 implement the invoice URL helper and its usage, and P1.F6.H1 and P1.F7.H1 extend the billing type and reason fields to support Vercel. P1.F14.H6 adds frontend state. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of backend implementation and helper functions, but the actual adoption, customer benefit, and operational stability of this new billing provider are not demonstrated by the code or observations. The score does not account for unverified outcomes or the potential broader impact of billing refactoring mentioned in P1.F7.H1.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is requested.

observations.behavior: Adds Vercel billing-managed customer support and refusal handling.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines a new API exception with status 400 and code billing_managed_by_provider, used when Vercel refuses a billing request.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper to extract Vercel invoices URL from organization integration.
observations.code_quote: def vercel_invoices_url(organization: Organization | None) -> str | None:
observations.posthog_connection: Checks OrganizationIntegration for Vercel kind and returns account URL, used to construct invoices URL for Vercel-managed billing.

observations.behavior: Replaces inline Vercel URL construction with vercel_invoices_url helper in billing response.
observations.posthog_connection: Uses the helper to populate external_billing_provider_invoices_url in billing response, supporting Vercel-managed billing display.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.behavior: Adds BillingProvider.Vercel and billing_provider support, including Vercel-managed billing and invoice URLs.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports Vercel as an external billing provider, allowing PostHog customers to use Vercel for billing and invoice management.

observations.behavior: Renames billingManagedByPartnerDisabledReason to selfServeBillingDisabledReason; this could indicate a broader refactoring or removal of partner-specific billing, not just Vercel.
observations.posthog_connection: Could indicate a broader billing refactoring, not just Vercel support. This could affect billing-related UI and backend compatibility.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a billing-related frontend change. It does not include backend implementation, tests, or configuration. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds billing state and computed values for Vercel-managed billing and self-serve billing disabled reasons.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds computed billing state for Vercel-managed accounts, including disabled reason and notice, alongside existing partner-managed billing. This could support a billing tier or managed account feature.
